prayers.invocationBody: Most Merciful Mother, remind us always about the Sorrows of your Son, Jesus.
prayers.offeringBody: My God, I offer You this Rosary for Your glory.
prayers.queenBody: Queen of Martyrs, your heart suffered so much.
prayers.conceivedBody: Mary, who was conceived without sin and who suffered for us, pray for us.

madonna_and_child.title: A Sorrow of Mary
madonna_and_child.description: And thy own soul a sword shall pierce.
